notes: 双机并发 push 同一配置仓库会让分支分叉，pull 的 merge --ff-only 拒绝非快进；此前只在失败后报笼统的「本地有未提交改动」，且逐项选「用本机/用云端」解决不了分叉。0.4.09 在冲突检测阶段就用 merge-base 判出分叉，把本地/云端各自领先提交数、base、处理步骤（保留本机=rebase 后推送；不要本机=reset --hard 到远端；双机固定一台推送）写进 sync-conflicts.json 的 divergence 字段，并同步展示在备份 README 与面板「同步冲突」卡；merge 失败分类也把分叉单独报出，不再误报成未提交改动。
notesEn: Two machines pushing to the same config repo diverge; pull merge --ff-only refuses non-fast-forward. Previously it only reported a generic "local changes" error after failure, and per-file cloud/local choices cannot fix a divergence. 0.4.09 detects divergence during conflict detection via merge-base, records local/remote ahead counts, base and steps (keep local = rebase then push; drop local = reset --hard to remote; fix one-pusher-one-puller) in the divergence field of sync-conflicts.json, shown in both the backup README and the panel Sync-conflicts card; the merge failure classification now reports divergence separately instead of mislabeling it as local changes.
